decision_rule: The repeating pattern is credited to counting characters when the two labellings' wavelengths differ by more than 3 characters, or when they disagree on whether they clear their own comparison. A gap of 3 characters or less with both labellings clearing credits token position instead.
metric: Gap in characters between the character-count pattern's wavelength and the token-position control's wavelength, after converting at the measured characters-per-token rate.
notes: A token's label here counts the sub-word tokens since the last line break. The rate that converts token periods into characters is measured on this probe window's own labelled held-out positions, and all three rates are recorded. A further run of this script on the same box is a rerun of the same instrument, not a replication.

values.not_computable_reason: distances [50, 51, 52] average zero label pairs, because the held-out documents carry no position at labels [51, 52, 53]; the committed profile length may not be shortened after the fact
values.run_void_reason: the anchor gate failed: held-out fit quality 0.859740 falls outside the measured band 0.767394 to 0.794606, so every result this run produces is an instrument fault and is not evidence about the model
